newsitem.title: USA: Micron to use Chromatic Research chip.
newsitem.headline: Micron to use Chromatic Research chip.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc will install multimedia chips and software from Chromatic Research Inc and Toshiba America Electronics Components Inc in its line Millennia personal computers, the companies said Monday.

The multimedia technology, called Mpact, is a combination of chips and software that enables PCs to display smooth-flowing video and better stereo sound. PCs need to have these capabilities to play movies and video stored on digital versatile disks, or DVDs.
Micron, the PC unit of chipmaker Micron Technology Inc MU.O, will put Mpact in its Millenia XRU and MME desktop PCs, the company said.
Chromatic Research, based in Sunnyvale, Calif., is a closely help semiconductor company that designs multimedia chips.
